question: Two sets of bottles where the TEOS-10 sigma-theta and the bottle database's own (DECODR) sigma_theta disagree by more than 0.1 kg m-3. (a) WITHHELD: all 918 bottles of cruise 2021-05-3322, where Salnty equals the bottle's own sigma_theta to 0.01 (24.19-27.06), so the salinity column holds sigma-theta (calcofi_bottle Q13); no spice or TEOS-10 sigma-theta is derived for them until Q13 is answered. Should their salinity be voided, or is it recoverable (the real salinity, or sigma-t to be re-scaled)? (b) 10 other bottles (2005-07-32NM, 2008-01-31JD x5, 2014-04-32I1, 2020-01-33UD, 2020-07-33P4 x2) differ by 0.105-0.786: was the legacy value computed from a different salinity or temperature than the one published?
context: Measured at the first render (2026-10-20, input release v2026.10.19, before the withholding) over 840,508 bottles with both values and an unflagged legacy sigma_theta: median |difference| 0.0041 kg m-3, p95 0.0109, p99 0.0154, max 7.20; 928 bottles past 0.1, 918 of them 2021-05-3322, which also held every spice below -3 (-5.7 to -3). The 2021-05-3322 bottles are unflagged in the source (S_qual above 9 is blanked as good by calcofi_bottle Q01) and inside the bounds, so they are withheld by name in the ingest (withheld_cruises), Ben Best 2026-10-20: a value we know is wrong never enters a derived product. The list of (b) is in the ingest's Findings section.
proposed_answer: (a) keep 2021-05-3322 withheld until calcofi_bottle Q13 is answered; then re-stage calcofi_bottle and drop the cruise from withheld_cruises. (b) the legacy value stays as published (DECODR's record) and the TEOS-10 value is computed from the published temperature and salinity; flag the bottle's salinity or temperature if it is the wrong input.

question: Is T_degC in the bottle database on the ITS-90 temperature scale throughout, including the bottles before 1990 (IPTS-68)? gsw_CT_from_t expects ITS-90.
context: The two scales differ by about 0.00024 x T (0.007 deg C at 30 deg C, under 0.005 deg C in most CalCOFI water), which moves sigma_theta_teos10 by under 0.002 kg/m3 and spice by a similar amount: below the bottle's own reporting precision. The derivation takes T_degC as ITS-90 for every year.
proposed_answer: treat T_degC as ITS-90 for every year (no conversion); the effect is below the bottle's precision
